title: Status
subtitle: A live check of the Verbatims API and its database connection.
healthy_description: The health endpoint responded and the database connection check succeeded.
degraded_description: The health endpoint responded, but the database connection check failed.
checking_description: Waiting for a response from the health endpoint.
unknown_description: No valid status data was received. The database state is unknown.
api_description: Confirms that this status endpoint returned a readable response.
database_description: Checks the database with a simple SELECT 1 query.
database_probe_failed_description: The check did not succeed; no successful query time is shown.
scope_note: This page checks only the API health endpoint and a SELECT 1 database query. It does not show uptime history or the status of third-party services.
